page_title: MON 1-1 ROM | Monza v AS Roma 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.

90+5' The ball rebounds out to Manu Kone (AS Roma) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
90+3' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+3' Ball possession – 34:66.
90+1' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Milan Djuric (Monza) for his blatant foul.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The game is interrupted now, Semuel Pizzignacco (Monza) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
88' The substitution is prepared. Gianluca Caprari (Monza) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Daniel Maldini.
87' PENALTY APPEAL after Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
86' Here is a change. Zeki Celik is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
86' Substitution. Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lorenzo Pellegrini walks off.
85' The corner from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is cleared away by the defence.
84' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
82' Pablo Mari (Monza) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Federico La Penna blows for a foul.
81' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) picks up a pass on the edge of the box and manages to get a powerful shot away, forcing the goalkeeper to scramble to his left and palm the ball away.
79' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) commits a rough challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
79' 3:13 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
76' Manu Kone (AS Roma) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
73' That's the end of the game for Pedro Pereira, who is replaced by Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza).
71' Ivan Juric has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) replacing Angelino.
71' It is time for a substitution. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) is on for Matias Soule.
70' 1 - 1 Goal! Dany Mota (Monza) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
68' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
68' Armando Izzo (Monza) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
67' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Angelino (AS Roma).
63' Alessandro Nesta has decided to substitute Alessandro Bianco and he is replaced by Dany Mota (Monza).
61' 0 - 1 Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Semuel Pizzignacco with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
60' The foul by Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Federico La Penna.

58' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
57' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
56' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
52' Daniel Maldini (Monza) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
50' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from AS Roma.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' The current number of shots on goal is 1:2.

45+1' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Angelino (AS Roma) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' The game is interrupted now, Milan Djuric (Monza) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
43' Daniel Maldini (Monza) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
42' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) serves up a nice cross, but Mile Svilar punches the ball away.
41' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

39' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the bottom right corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Semuel Pizzignacco makes a comfortable save.
35' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
31' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
30' The resulting corner from Daniel Maldini (Monza) is cleared by the defence.
29' Foul! Zeki Celik (AS Roma) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
27' A quickly taken corner by AS Roma.
26' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Matias Soule (AS Roma) for a tough tackle.

23' Golden chance! Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.

22' That was close by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
21' The linesman points to the corner flag, AS Roma are going to take it.
20' Ivan Juric is forced to make a change. Stephan El Shaarawy is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma).
20' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
18' Great save! Daniel Maldini (Monza) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Mile Svilar.
16' The goal by AS Roma won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
16' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Federico La Penna wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
15' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) has a goal ruled out for offside!
9' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
8' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
6' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
3' Federico La Penna couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alessandro Bianco (Monza) and blew his whistle.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
AS Roma will kick the game off.
Federico La Penna is the one to supervise the game today.
